controls.micLabelPushToTalk: Push to talk armed. Hold {{combo}} to transmit

share.heading: Share screen
share.audioScopeSource: Shares the audio of whatever you pick.
share.audioScopeSystem: Shares everything your computer is playing.
share.audioExcludesCall: The call itself is never included.

inputMode.heading: Input Mode
inputMode.voiceActivityHint: Your microphone is open whenever you are not muted. Best with headphones and a quiet room.
inputMode.pushToTalkHint: Your microphone is off until you hold <combo>{{combo}}</combo>, and closes again the moment you let go — or if the window loses focus. Rebind it in Key Bindings.

channel.deleteWarning: This voice channel and any in-call state will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Voice & Video
settings.speaker: Speaker
settings.previewOff: Preview is off — turn it on to check your camera.
settings.hearMyselfDescription: Loops the mic back through the selected output. Use headphones to avoid feedback.
settings.micBoostSublabel: Adds extra volume to your mic before anything else processes it. Use this if you're still too quiet even at full system volume.
settings.autoVolumeLevelingDescription: Keeps your voice at a consistent level — quiet speech is brought up, loud bursts are reined in. Turn off if you'd rather set mic volume yourself.
settings.autoVolumeTargetSublabel: How loud Auto Volume Leveling tries to make you. Lower = louder (3 may clip on a hot mic), higher = quieter. Most people are happy at 6.
settings.noiseSuppressionHint: Filters out background hum, fans, and traffic. Higher settings also strip away quieter speech, so leave at Moderate unless your room is noisy.
settings.echoCancellationDescription: Stops your speaker audio from being picked up by your mic and sent back to others. Leave on unless you're always on headphones.
settings.clickSuppressionDescription: A smarter noise filter that catches keyboard typing and mouse clicks the regular Noise Suppression misses. Uses about 5% of one CPU core. Tip: turn Noise Suppression down to Low or Off when this is on so they don't fight each other.
settings.fpsHint: {{hint}}. Higher is smoother for video and gameplay but uses more CPU and bandwidth; drop to 15 fps for documents or a constrained machine/network. Takes effect on your next screen share.
settings.autoJoinVoiceDescription: Automatically join voice when opening a voice channel. Disable to preview who's in the channel before joining.
settings.screenShareAudioDescription: Include your computer's audio when you share a screen. The call itself is never included. On Linux this is the only place to turn it on, because the system dialog handles source selection.

joinError.unreachable: Couldn't reach the voice server — check your connection and try again.
joinError.notConfigured: Voice is not configured on this server.

shareError.cancelled: Screen share cancelled — no window or screen was picked.
shareError.unsupportedDesktop: Screen sharing isn't available on this desktop environment. It has no screen-sharing backend (xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast). Use GNOME, KDE, or an X11 session.
shareError.permission: Allow Pollis in macOS Privacy → Screen Recording.
shareError.helperMissing: Screen share helper is missing. Reinstall Pollis to restore it.
shareError.portal: Screen share is unavailable — the desktop screen-sharing portal did not respond.

cameraError.unsupported: Webcam capture isn't available on this platform yet.
cameraError.permission: Camera access is blocked. Grant Pollis camera permission, then try again.
cameraError.busy: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
cameraError.helperMissing: Camera helper is missing. Reinstall Pollis to restore it.
